column1: # The `--frame-ancestors <source>` grammar's shared case table (app#520, ADR-0044).
# FRAME_ANCESTORS is the CSP `frame-ancestors` source list the ttyd-proxy sidecar stamps on
# every ttyd response: the origins that may put the root-shell terminal in an <iframe>. The
# grammar is EXACTLY ONE source: the quoted lower-case keyword 'none' (nobody may frame it:
# the chart's default), or `https://` and one host of the same RFC 1123 grammar as
# no port, no trailing dot). The whole value is at most 261 characters (`https://` and 253);
# a regex cannot count the whole, so each reader checks the length after the pattern
# Out, and why: 'self' (ttyd's own origin only frames itself: no use), `*` and `*.` (anyone may
# frame a root shell), a scheme alone and `http://` (the session cookie is Secure +
# SameSite=None: an http parent has no session), a port, a path, a trailing `/`, a query,
# userinfo, an upper-case letter (one canonical form), more than one source (a space, `,` or
# `;`: ADR-0013 made the origin a single one), any other keyword, nonce or hash, and a bare
# `none` (a host named none: a misconfiguration that reads as safe).
# The one definition is the Go constant ttydproxy.FrameAncestorsPattern. The readers:
#   - Go:    internal/ttydproxy (frame_ancestors_grammar_test.go) pins this header, the shell
#            literal and the constant equal, the host part composed from dnsname.Body (ADR-0047), runs
#            every row through the constant and through New (a refusal to start).
#   - shell: charts/ctf-user/deploy-user.sh, run row by row as `--frame-ancestors <input>` by
# An empty value has no row: `--frame-ancestors ""` is the flag parser's usage error (exit 1)
# and an empty FRAME_ANCESTORS env is New's default, 'none'. The pairing with --app-host
# (D3) is not a row of this table: it is two inputs, and check-deploy-user-ids.sh holds it.
# Format: the same as internal/identity/testdata/seat-cases.tsv (see its header):
# line 1 the canonical `# pattern: ` literal. The table stays ASCII. A row is never dropped to
# make an implementation pass: the implementation that disagrees is the bug.
# --- baseline: what is deployed (a synthetic host of the shape platform passes: https://<appHost>)
# --- length: a label is at most 63, the whole value at most 261 (https:// and a 253-character host)
# --- the keyword: exactly 'none', quoted, lower case, alone
# --- not a source this deployment allows: 'self', a wildcard, a scheme alone, another keyword, nonce or hash
# --- https only, one canonical form: no http, no upper case, no port, path, `/`, query, fragment or userinfo
# --- the host: RFC 1123 labels, no empty label, no trailing dot, no underscore
# --- one source only: a second origin, a `,` (helm --set syntax: another key), a `;` (another CSP directive)
# --- line breaks, a bidi control, a non-ASCII letter
